source: bvcomm (fibre, technicien de dos), observatoire-des-cse (salle de réunion vide, note 90), loeilsingulier (plan de table, papier coton, brume, sections notées 4-5 ; quatuor à silhouette en trop), tvcentreduquebec (enveloppe, notée 4-5), gdreseau (notée 4-5), dmca.
style: Editorial commercial photography, calm and precise, {ambiance} mood, palette of {palette}, {lumiere}, tactile {matieres}, set in {lieu} on {saison}, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, calm minimal composition with generous empty space, photorealistic, high detail.
interdits: No screen with readable content, no chart with numbers, no handshake, no puzzle pieces, no thumbs up, nobody looking at the camera, no client logos, no fake document.
evite: Évite la banque d'images (poignées de main, sourires) et les écrans lisibles : objets de travail vierges, lieux vides, personnes de dos.

404.consigne: A single plain unopened envelope lying on a bare table, soft early-morning window light from the left, a coffee cup partly out of frame, calm, a gentle touch of humour, no writing.

ouverture.consigne: Extreme close-up of {sujet} glowing softly in the dark, strands entering from one edge and converging, soft round bokeh in the background.
ouverture.evite: Le cliché du réseau en hologramme (« no holograms or futuristic overlays »).

section-fond.consigne: Seamless top-down macro of thick ivory cotton paper, soft visible fibres, very subtle natural irregularities, evenly lit with no shadows, no objects, no folds.

scene-metier.consigne: Overhead flat lay on a large table of {sujet}, a hand-drawn plan made only of circles and lines with absolutely no writing, a fountain pen, generous empty space in the centre of the frame.

lieu.consigne: An empty meeting room in early morning: a long pale wooden table, a few chairs pushed back as if people just left, an open notebook with blank pages, {lumiere}, nobody.

texture.consigne: Minimalist {matieres} at dawn: soft mist, a faint pale line of light on the horizon, no land, no boats, no buildings, large areas of quiet empty sky.
texture.evite: Les éléments narratifs dans un fond.

portrait-generique.consigne: A person seen from behind and slightly to the side, sitting at a desk in a bright open-plan office that is softly blurred, only the back of the head and a shoulder visible, screen turned away, no face.
portrait-generique.evite: Le casque-micro au sourire figé, face caméra.
